mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 3 months compresses discount rates and stimulates equity market returns, producing positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in declining FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation, leading to negative 20-day forward returns as the Fed is forced to tighten monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 40% of triggered instances despite CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in retail sales (RSAFS) signals a strong labor market and consumer spending, leading to positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in < 40% of instances where UNRATE change < -0.2pp AND RSAFS change > 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100), the S&P 500 tends to produce negative 60-day forward returns as the economy enters a slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in < 40% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A strong GDP growth (GDPC1) in the latest quarter signals a robust economy, leading to positive 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in strong GDP growth periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 5.5% in a single month, it signals a deteriorating labor market, leading to negative 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in < 40% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 5.5%), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPI (CPIAUCSL) and fall in FEDFUNDS (indicating the Fed is not responding to inflation) leads to negative 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0% AND FEDFUNDS change < -0.5%
regime_hint: inflationary pressure with inadequate monetary response
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0% AND FEDFUNDS change < -0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of low housing starts (HOUST < 1000), the S&P 500 tends to produce negative 60-day forward returns as the housing market contraction signals a broader economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in < 40% of instances where HOUST < 1000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
